region_id_mapping.note: Task/platform IDs encode a two-digit row-major region ordinal; 00..08 map to contract region coordinates r00,r01,r02,r10,r11,r12,r20,r21,r22.

live_safety_receipt_audit.interpretation: trajectory disposition receipt cross-check and forced-state counts only; does not establish all hard constraints or method safety

train.method: percentile bootstrap of scenario means; states averaged within scenario; 10000 replicates; seed=33303
train.interpretation: descriptive label-gain summary, not a strategy or cross-region treatment-effect interval

validation.method: percentile bootstrap of scenario means; states averaged within scenario; 10000 replicates; seed=33303
validation.interpretation: descriptive label-gain summary, not a strategy or cross-region treatment-effect interval

cost_semantics.completed_residual_penalty: zero (completed endpoint tasks are scored as complete and skipped in residual accumulation)

resource_evidence.memory_peak: UNKNOWN: commit records contain RSS at receipt, not peak RSS
resource_evidence.platform_usage: present per scenario header; not a host CPU resource measure

selected_cross_region_decomposition.interpretation: descriptive selected-cross-region subset; not a pure cross-region causal effect
